Hymn 26: Joseph Smith's First Prayer
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: G Major
Composer: Sylvanus Billings Pond
Lyricist/Text Author: George Manwaring
Category: Restoration

This is hymn number 26 titled "Joseph Smith's First Prayer" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in G Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Sylvanus Billings Pond and the lyrics were written by George Manwaring.
This hymn is categorized under: Restoration.
